service.description: The records awaiting adoption: the campaigns with no organization, the lists that are not mailboxes and the segments whose owner is empty or _NA_, at most 200 of each, each with recordKind (campaign, list, segment), kindName, recordId, label, detail (status or type), lastUpdatedStamp (the revision apply#Adoption names) and revision (the same as millis, for a form); counts by kind. Changes nothing. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

Assigns each record of assignments (maps of recordKind, recordId, organizationPartyId and the lastUpdatedStamp read) to an organization of the administrator's scope, each on its own transaction with one result: a list's or a segment's ownerPartyId, or a campaign's organizationPartyId with its dated MarketingOrganization MarketingCampaignParty row, each audited with the change reason "Adopted by" the administrator. Unknown historical consent stays unknown: nothing but the owner changes. A result is adopted, or refused by reasonCode with the others applied: UNKNOWN_KIND; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for a record that is missing or a mailbox; ALREADY_OWNED for a record that belongs to an organization (an adoption applies once per record); REVISION_CHANGED for a revision that is not the one read, naming the current one; ORGANIZATION_DENIED for an organization outside the scope. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: assignments
parameter.description: Maps of recordKind, recordId, organizationPartyId and lastUpdatedStamp (a Timestamp or its millis; checked when given)
